categories.name: Economics
categories.description: Programs in economic theory and its applications — micro and macroeconomics, econometrics, and fields such as financial, international, and public economics — offered as BA and BSc degrees across faculties of arts and social science.

tips.title: Join an investment or economics club
tips.detail: Run a mock stock portfolio, enter DECA's finance and economics events, or organize a stock-pitch night at school. Sustained involvement produces the specific analysis and presentation examples supplementary applications ask for.

tips.title: Write the Euclid and CSMC math contests
tips.detail: Economics degrees lean on calculus and statistics from first year, and contest results give admissions a standardized signal of quantitative strength beyond course marks — useful for profile-based reviews like UBC's Personal Profile.

tips.title: Follow real economic policy and write about it
tips.detail: Track the Bank of Canada's rate announcements and Monetary Policy Report, then turn that reading into something concrete: an entry in a student economics essay competition, a school-paper column, or a club presentation on a current policy question.
